parts.visual:
## The Super 'S' 🦸

He/She/It needs an **S**.

* Work ➔ Works
* Watch ➔ Watches
* Study ➔ Studies
* Have ➔ **Has** (Irregular!)
parts.audio: Welcome. To talk about daily life, you need to master the third person. Remember the spelling rules. It's not always just adding an S. Watch out for 'Has'!
Where do you put 'always'? Before the action. I ALWAYS eat breakfast. I NEVER wake up late.

stages.title: The Interview
stages.scenario: Estás en una entrevista de trabajo. El reclutador quiere saber si eres organizado.
stages.ai_system_prompt: ROLE: Strict HR Manager. GOAL: Ask 'What time do you wake up?' and 'Do you work on weekends?'. Verify Prepositions and Present Simple.
stages.initial_message: Have a seat. I need productive people. Tell me, what time do you usually wake up?
